what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as accounts.audit. Looked for a way to add a client in: the top + (New) menu (only Cost or purchase / Record payment), Money > Books (has + New vendor, a supplier form with GST treatment, payment terms and billing address, but that is for suppliers so I did not use it), Sales & receipts (only a Client dropdown on New quote, no add option), Receipts & retainers (Client dropdown only), Ledger & setup, Budgets and costs, Reports & tax, Tax & Recurring, Projects, Inbox, search for 'client' (only finds screens), and the Ask assistant (replied it can only help with projects, tasks, expenses/purchases and budget questions). No client was created. I found no screen to add a client.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: Money > Sales & receipts > New quote (client dropdown only)
unnecessary_steps: Many Money sub-tabs had to be opened one by one because nothing signals where client records live
confusing_terminology: New vendor -> only supplier creation is offered; unclear whether clients share this
Receipts & retainers -> unclear what it holds
Ledger & setup -> 'setup' does not include client setup
missing_feedback: Client dropdowns offer no 'add new client' option or hint
Search for 'client' gives no result for creating one
unexpected_behaviour: New vendor form pre-fills example-looking placeholder text, and the description says 'Zoho-style', referencing another product
Ask assistant gave a generic capability reply instead of saying clients cannot be added
errors_encountered: I can help create projects and tasks, record expenses or purchases, and answer budget and activity questions.
visual_issues: Sales page buttons Quotes/Invoices/New quote/Credit note look similar, with New quote highlighted as if selected
Tab selected state differs between top tabs and sub tabs
accessibility_issues: Top-right icon buttons (search, location, +) have no visible text labels
observations: Add client feature appears absent for the accounts role, or hidden. Clients seem to exist only as a name on projects and in dropdowns. Layout is otherwise clean and readable.

rating_justifications.feature_discoverability: After about 45 actions across every Money tab, Projects, Inbox, search, + menu and Ask, no way to add a client was found.
rating_justifications.ease_of_use: The task could not be done; only a supplier form was available.
rating_justifications.system_feedback: Search and Ask gave no hint that client creation is unsupported or where to go.
rating_justifications.overall_user_experience: Core task impossible to complete or locate.
